{{Quote|The armistice brought about by the Pellaeon—Gavrisorn treaty was a durable peace. Three long, quiet years passed, blissfully uninterrupted by Imperial schemes, mad Jedi, local brushfires, or unexpected alien invasions.|Voren Na'al|<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
The following events took place in '''21 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
{{Quote|Interplanetary squabbles and trade conﬂicts were as much a constant as always. At the urging of her friends in the government, Leia Organa Solo ran again for the post of New Republic Chief of State, and was elected back into that office in 21 ABY.|Voren Na'al|<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" />}}
*[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] re-elected as [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TNEC" /><ref name="NEGTC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>
*The [[Intimidator (Executor-class)|''Intimidator'']] was found destroyed near the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>
*[[Viqi Shesh]] was elected to represent the [[Kuat sector/Legends|Kuat sector]] in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]].
*[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] enjoyed their second honeymoon on [[Maicombe]].<ref name="JC">"[[Judge's Call]]"</ref>
*[[Dean Jinzler]] joined [[Talon Karrde]]'s intelligence organization {{Circa}}.<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>
*The [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] [[Cindel Towani]] presented evidence that the [[Lost Prophet]] of [[Du Mai]] was a former [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] who had suffered head injuries.<ref name="EGTW Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

==Deaths==
{{Quote|I put Shysa out of his misery. We were surrounded, he was too badly hurt to escape, and I couldn't leave him to the Sevvets.|Boba Fett to Goran Beviin|<ref name="Legacy of the Force">''[[Legacy of the Force: Revelation]]''</ref>}}
*[[Fenn Shysa]] on [[Shogun (planet)|Shogun]]<ref name="GAW119">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref>
